tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/ nga)pa la/ gzhan bskul

gyi ngor bris pa'i smon lam gyi skor phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa nor bu'i mdzod khang ldeb/ 69 phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i dgongs don snying por dril ba byin rlabs bum bzang ldeb/ 8 smin byed dbang dang grol lam phyag rgya chen po'i gnad don dris bar lan du phuul ba bskal bzang dga' byed bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo ldeb/ 83 chos tshul sna tshogs las brtsams te 'bel gtam bgyis pa'i rabs me tog chun 'phyang ldeb/ 70 sprul pa'i skyes mchog mi pham mgon pos dri ba snga phyir mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa ldeb/ 27 sman sgom dri lan gnyis chos zung 'jug gi ngo sprod zhal gdams ldeb/ 11 bcas bzhugs/
